scope: Forwarding inventory only; no production correction or acceptance. Runtime tokens, operation keys, identities, values and UI images remain private.

operationClassification.allowed: Only mesh_forward_list {} and mesh_forward_status {key} for known synthetic exact lowercase32-hex keys, plus bounded common bootstrap reads.
operationClassification.refused: All other operations and unexpected arguments, including mesh_forward_start/stop/recover. No mutating confirmation is invoked.
operationClassification.localOnly: Actual prepareForwardSource/forwardSourceDraft generates a fresh fixture-only random key/token/digest in browser memory. No listening endpoint, real credential, permission or admission is created. Local Review Stop/Review local recovery only project presentation.
operationClassification.contracts: Source-shaped historical status DTOs include exact runtime identifiers,64-character valid service, signed-int64 grant revision kept as BigInt,1024-character uncertainty failure and valid loopback bind. Local draft uses actual validator, safe integer revision,15-minute maximum and4096-character reason. No Go/wire/live validation claim.

findings.problem: A disconnected exact-status attempt with a previously successful known valid key reports an invalid-key instruction.
findings.evidence: All four cases retain the valid lookup across synthetic disconnect; Inspect sends zero read calls and shows the exact32-hex-key instruction. Source combines connection and key validation under the same message.
findings.proposedScope: Existing noninteractive forwarding status/message Text. A future scoped correction can distinguish reconnect guidance from malformed input while preserving the same read guards and exact key validation. No correction applied.

findings.problem: An unsent prepared private source remains presented after editable form fields change, while its review summary omits reason and lifetime.
findings.evidence: All four cases retain the same private leaf/value after an unsent reason edit. Source showPrepared captures the prior request; the summary lists route/revision/bind but not reason/lifetime. A new explicit preparation replaces and clears the old leaf. No start request was invoked, so execution behavior is source-qualified rather than experimentally tested.
findings.proposedScope: Existing Exact source review Card/body Stack and local informational Text: clarify the immutable prepared snapshot versus editable inputs and show complete review data. Preserve sent/uncertain/token-retention and retry/admission boundaries; do not automatically erase uncertain credentials. No new authority or correction proposed by execution.

allocationAssessment.reason: Measured form captions, controls and review warnings fit sampled own allocations/true clips. Width cap alone is not a defect. Tall dense status prose and selected-scale prepared summary require native vertical scrolling; they are not classified as unreadable from whole-box height alone.
allocationAssessment.warningReach: Actual native scrollers/keys reach first/middle/final Stop and recovery warning ranges in all four cases. Full dense uncertainty-prose range reach was not separately sampled; complete text is retained privately and vertical-height qualification remains.
allocationAssessment.nativeClose: Inherited negative close margins can exceed the header box while staying inside the native panel clip; no close/layout correction is inferred from that alone.
allocationAssessment.futureAllocationBoundary: If separately demonstrated by expanded evidence, use only existing forwarding root/form/review/records Stacks and Cards and lookup-row containment. This inventory does not justify widening the native Dialog or a global rule.

privateLeafEvidence.qualification: DOM/property/persistence/RPC observations and source-reviewed no-output island only. Runtime RDF/LDES was not exported or inspected in these browser cohorts; no memory-zeroization/GC or real credential claim.

Whole rows/controls are measured with individual native scrolling. No simultaneous visibility or full dense-prose end-to-end reach claim.
Actual read capture/release and awaited original context/browser/server API-close promises do not establish OS process-group exit/reap or live listener cleanup.
No real host/cluster/forwarding/listener/token/network/backend effect or mutation/CAS/unknown/retry/admission exercise. Start/Stop/recover uncertainty paths remain source-reviewed only.

Raw tokens, keys, identities, values and private UI snapshots are excluded from this normalized record and remain in the private artifact bundle. Independent review and broader UX/TUI/live acceptance remain open.
